in_marathi.name: Asit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asit is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Asadh’ meaning 'dawn' or 'daybreak'. In Hindu mythology, Asit is a name of the sun god, Surya. It is also the name of one of the nine planets in Hindu astronomy, known as Shukla-Pitr or Sukra, representing the planet Venus.
